description:
Owner question (2026-09-03): is the static census a necessary evil to keep
after the fz-kdt arc? No, not in its current shape. The seating law -- no arm
seated ahead of one whose surface it does not cover -- is a debug_assert
inside specificity_order (every_inversion_covers), and the fixture matrix
drives every fixture through a debug build, so every call-edge plan is
already checked in production on every matrix run. The seat gate over
ARM_ORDER_CENSUS (22 fixtures) is redundant for call-edge plans TODAY and is
not redundant for wrapper member selection only because
dispatch_from_callable_flow_edges bypasses specificity_order (fz-kdt.179).
The census gates cost ~120 s of every lib run (lib ~100 s -> 221 s at
fz-kdt.178; fz-kdt.195 counts the recompiles).

AFTER fz-kdt.179 LANDS (members seated by the same relation, so the
production debug_assert covers every plan kind the seat owns):
1. DELETE compiler2_dispatch_seats_the_covering_arm_where_one_covers and
   SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE (the allowance is 179's reproducer and empties
   with it); the law's gate is the debug_assert plus the matrix.
2. DELETE the corpus walk in compiler2_dispatch_lists_its_bodies_in_the_
   graphs_first_match_order; keep the property as ONE unit test over a
   constructed PatternDispatchPlan (it is a fact about compile_dispatch_
   matrix, not about fixtures).
3. COLLAPSE compiler2_dispatch_blind_escape_census_is_the_known_population
   and compiler2_dispatch_offers_no_runtime_indistinguishable_arm into one
   RESIDUE ratchet: the named pairs no seat can decide (fz-kdt.131 facet 3;
   twins that survive 179), each compiled ONCE (fz-kdt.195's cache or a
   fixture list that contains only residue carriers), with the arrival-
   permutation drive (fz-kdt.141) run as an instrument when a dispatch rule
   changes -- not on every lib run.
4. KEEP the dynamic tripwire (env-gated, zero production cost) and its
   15-row census; keep SOURCE_ORDER_PLANS_ON_THE_CENSUS only until fz-kdt.187
   makes the entry class readable, then fold it into the residue ratchet.
5. When fz-kdt.131's residue is cured, the ratchet asserts EMPTINESS on one
   fixture per class or is deleted.
CONCORDANCE: fz-kdt.195 (compile once per arrival -- a cost fix this ticket
mostly makes unnecessary), fz-kdt.141 (the stress instrument stays), fz-
kdt.131 (owns the residue the ratchet names), fz-kdt.78 (explicit gate
ownership per fixture), fz-kdt.179 (the prerequisite). Acceptance: lib wall
clock back near its pre-178 figure with every law still held, and the
matrix's debug build stated as the seat law's gate in dispatch-matrix.md.
title: Retire the static seat census once member selection runs through the seat: the law lives in specificity_order's debug_assert, the census keeps only the named residue
